line_center_y.description: y coordinate along the transverse centre line (x = length / 2), mm

line_center_sigma_xx.description: sigma_xx along the transverse centre line, MPa

line_center_sigma_yy.description: sigma_yy along the transverse centre line, MPa

line_center_sigma_xy.description: sigma_xy along the transverse centre line, MPa

line_center_Distance.description: Arc length along the transverse centre line, mm

sigma_xx_r.description: sigma_xx at the hole edge (r = radius, theta = pi / 2), MPa

sigma_xx_d0.description: sigma_xx one stress-point distance past the hole edge (r = radius + d0, theta = pi / 2), MPa

crit.description: Peak fibre-direction failure criterion over the criterion mesh (failure at 1)

sigma_xx_max.description: Maximum sigma_xx over the criterion mesh, MPa

sigma_xx_min.description: Minimum sigma_xx over the criterion mesh, MPa
